comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference affected the official outcome; both implemented enough behavior to pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split research into five probe children plus a synthesizer while the parent separately owned implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial disabled workflows and kept probing, implementation, validation, and final explanation in one parent trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated the same findings locally, then used them directly to fix linecache and separator behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a report-to-synthesizer handoff boundary; serial avoided inter-agent handoff and preserved context in one trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent wrote many helper modules and test9.mjs itself after independent probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a smaller modular tree and later edited argparse after finding the trailing separator mismatch.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; it completed final validation and returned a final answer.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel passed sample checks and official evaluation, but its comprehensive differential harness was killed before reporting results.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed 106-case regressions from three directories, separator checks, fuzzing, Unicode digit checks, and help diff before official pass.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had stronger completed local acceptance evidence; parallel relied on partial local evidence plus the later official evaluator.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full agent budget and ended with return code 143, agent_timeout, process_ok false, and no final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed with return code 0, agent_completed, process_ok true, and 815 seconds remaining.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main adverse difference is budget/closure: parallel passed officially but did not complete its own closure path, while serial did.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both completed evaluations passed 124 of 124 samples. The concrete difference is that parallel achieved a passing artifact despite exhausting its process budget and leaving local differential verification and final response unfinished, while serial completed the same implementation and validation workflow normally.
parallel_contributors: Parallel parent independently produced a correct artifact and official evaluation passed.
The parallel workflow and parent-side difftest consumed the closure budget and the process timed out.
serial_contributors: Serial single-agent path completed linecache and separator fixes, full regression, fuzzing, and final response.
Serial completed normally with remaining budget and no delegation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial explicitly found and fixed trailing '--' separator behavior during local regression; parallel did not finish an equivalent local difftest, though official tests still passed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern describes adverse parallel process consequences only
